fact: The Council of Ministers of 1 June 2022 adopted a draft decree approving the single-lot contract for the Projet d'Accès au service de télécommunication des collectivités territoriales, awarded to SIMO TELECOM for about 9.407 billion FCFA with twelve months to deliver; its communiqué says the project is entirely financed by AGEFAU, installs telecommunications infrastructure at the collectivités territoriales and gives the administration its own secure, autonomous network.
title: Collectivités territoriales du Mali : La mise en place du Projet de leur accès au service de télécommunication se formalise
